HMS-2: shows "-" when the patient has no upcoming Scheduled appointment

findings.suggested_fix: Start each test name with the PRD ID for the patient list's Next appointment column (for example PAT-2), and keep HMS-2 in the describe block.
findings.text: The strategy says test names start with a PRD requirement ID, as the existing tests do with PAT-n. The new test names start with the ticket key HMS-2 instead.

questions.text: Should UI defect tests start their names with the PRD requirement ID (for example PAT-2) or with the ticket key (HMS-2)? The strategy only names PRD IDs.

rubric_items.reason: The change touched one line, the empty branch of the Next appointment cell. T-1 tests that branch and T-2 tests the unchanged non-empty branch, so every changed path is tested.

The assertions check things a user can see: the exact text "-", that no link is shown, and the /appointments/7 link with the doctor's name. I could not read the test source, so they are judged from the artifact's description only.
It covers the null next_appointment edge, which is the fix. No error path, such as a failed API stub, is tested. The change is UI-only and touches no endpoint, so the major trigger does not apply.
It uses Vitest, jsdom and Testing Library in web/src/__tests__, as the strategy says. One small deviation: test names start with the ticket key HMS-2 rather than a PRD requirement ID.
The artifact states no numbers, and the verifier test log shows the PatientsPage tests passing. But it says coverage comes from the verifier, and the verifier skipped coverage.
